This repository contains the interactive presentation and executive synthesis deck: **"CRISPR-Cas9 as a Universal Programmable Biological Editing Platform: Bridging Macromolecular Architecture, In Vivo Delivery, and Clinical Translation"**.

## Slide-by-Slide Outline (13 Slides)
1. **Slide 1: Title Slide** — Universal Programmable Biological Editing Platform.
2. **Slide 2: Executive Summary & Paradigm Shift** — Programmability, Modularity, and Scalability.
3. **Slide 3: Macromolecular Architecture & Mechanics** — Bi-lobed SpCas9 (REC/NUC), HNH/RuvC, PAM 5'-NGG-3', and 4-stage R-loop kinetics.
4. **Slide 4: Expanding Beyond Nuclease Activity** — CRISPRi/a, Cytosine/Adenine Base Editors (CBE/ABE), and Prime Editing.
5. **Slide 5: Case Study 1 (Ex Vivo Hemoglobinopathies)** — Autologous CD34+ HSPCs, BCL11A enhancer disruption, and curative HbF reactivation (>40% HbF, 0 VOCs).
6. **Slide 6: Case Study 2 (In Vivo LNP Systemic Delivery)** — NTLA-2001, ApoE-LDLR hepatocyte targeting, endosomal proton-sponge escape, and lifelong TTR knockout (~97% reduction).
7. **Slide 7: Case Study 3 (Spatiotemporal Control)** — Optogenetic photoactivatable Cas9 (paCas9) vs. Chemically Inducible Dimerization (CID) switches.
8. **Slide 8: Case Study 4 (Agricultural Biofortification)** — Hexaploid wheat *TaMLO1* knockout across A/B/D subgenomes for powdery mildew resistance; non-transgenic RNP protoplasts.
9. **Slide 9: Case Study 5 (Microbiology & Diagnostics)** — Targeted conjugative plasmid curing (>99.9% superbug eradication) & SHERLOCK/DETECTR attomolar collateral diagnostics.
10. **Slide 10: Case Study 6 (Logic Gates & Bioinformatics)** — dCas9 AND/OR synthetic circuits, CAMERA memory recording, and DeepSpCas9 CNN design pipelines.
11. **Slide 11: Preclinical Validation & Biosafety** — GUIDE-seq, Digenome-seq, SpCas9-HF1/HypaCas9 high-fidelity engineering, and immunogenicity mitigation.
12. **Slide 12: Future Clinical Horizons & Regulations** — Multiplexed allogeneic off-the-shelf CAR-T (TRAC/B2M/PD-1 knockout), latent HIV-1 proviral excision, and global CMC standards.
13. **Slide 13: Conclusion & Master Reference Corpus** — Executive closing and landmark citations (Jinek et al. 2012, Cong/Mali 2013, Frangoul et al. 2021, Gillmore et al. 2021, Anzalone et al. 2019, Gootenberg et al. 2017).

## Interactive Presentation Controls & Shortcuts
| Key / Control | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| `→` / `↓` / `Space` / `PageDown` | Advance to Next Slide |
| `←` / `↑` / `PageUp` | Return to Previous Slide |
| `Home` / `End` | Jump to First / Last Slide |
| `O` / `Tab` | Open / Close Slide Overview Thumbnail Grid |
| `N` | Toggle Presenter Speaker Notes Drawer |
| `F` | Toggle Fullscreen Mode |
| `P` | Open Print / Export to PDF Dialog |
| `Esc` | Close any active modal or drawer |
